title: Define Phase 2 domain types and versioned local storage migration
acceptance_criteria: Types represent multiple named routines, a weekly recurring schedule with day/time/routine assignment, and reminder settings including enabled state and notification capability state.
A versioned storage envelope and adapter centralize reads/writes instead of scattering raw localStorage parsing across components.
Legacy move-well-exercises and move-well-routine data is migrated without losing valid exercises or routine exercise selections.
Malformed, unsupported, or unavailable storage data falls back to safe defaults and does not throw during app startup.
Storage migration and validation behavior has deterministic unit tests, and the test command is configured in web/package.json.
completion_summary: Added validated versioned storage types, legacy migration, safe adapter, deterministic tests, and Vitest config.
